text.text: The park and school complex at the heart of the amenity core.
Pocket parks on the plots that road widening frees in the old area.
Every space is a short walk from every home. Trees and canopies shade the breeze corridors, and the public beach gives the sea back to the city, with a path to the beach every 60 m.
